names("Egert Facility"; "Falston LCS"; "Tevatron LHC"; "Zynga Complex").
year(2016; 2017; 2018; 2019).
scientist("Dr. Baldwin"; "Dr. Ewing"; "Dr. Kirk"; "Dr. Quinn").

% For each name, it is matched with exactly one year and one scientist.
{accelerator(Name, Year, Scientist): year(Year), scientist(Scientist)}=1 :- names(Name).

% No option in any category will ever be used more than once.
{N1=N2; Y1=Y2; S1=S2}=0 :- accelerator(N1,Y1,S1), accelerator(N2,Y2,S2), (N1,Y1,S1)!=(N2,Y2,S2).

% 1. The Tevatron LHC is either the facility scheduled to go online in 2019 or the accelerator scheduled to go online in 2016.
{Y=2019; Y=2016}=1 :- accelerator(N,Y,S), N="Tevatron LHC".

% 2.1 The project headed by Dr. Baldwin and the project headed by Dr. Quinn are different.
S1!=S2 :- accelerator(N1,Y1,S1), accelerator(N2,Y2,S2), S1="Dr. Baldwin", S2="Dr. Quinn".

% 2.2 The project headed by Dr. Baldwin is the Falston LCS or will go online in 2017.
{N="Falston LCS"; Y=2017}=1 :- accelerator(N,Y,S), S="Dr. Baldwin".

% 2.3 The project headed by Dr. Quinn is the Falston LCS or will go online in 2017.
{N="Falston LCS"; Y=2017}=1 :- accelerator(N,Y,S), S="Dr. Quinn".

% 3. The project headed by Dr. Ewing will go online sometime before the Zynga Complex.
Y1<Y2 :- accelerator(N1,Y1,S1), accelerator(N2,Y2,S2), S1="Dr. Ewing", N2="Zynga Complex".

% 4.1 The project headed by Dr. Ewing and the facility scheduled to go online in 2018 are different.
N1!=N2 :- accelerator(N1,Y1,S1), accelerator(N2,Y2,S2), S1="Dr. Ewing", Y2=2018.

% 4.2 The project headed by Dr. Ewing is the Egert Facility or is the Tevatron LHC.
{N="Egert Facility"; N="Tevatron LHC"}=1 :- accelerator(N,Y,S), S="Dr. Ewing".

% 4.3 The facility scheduled to go online in 2018 is the Egert Facility or is the Tevatron LHC.
{N="Egert Facility"; N="Tevatron LHC"}=1 :- accelerator(N,Y,S), Y=2018.

% 5. The Zynga Complex is headed by Dr. Baldwin.
S="Dr. Baldwin" :- accelerator(N,Y,S), N="Zynga Complex".
